#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hopsworks
import hsfs.core
import json
import os

# Login to Hopsworks
hopsworks.login()

# Get APIs
fg_api = hsfs.core.feature_group_api.FeatureGroupApi()
stats_api = hsfs.core.statistics_api.StatisticsApi()

# List existing feature groups
print("Listing feature groups...")
feature_groups = fg_api.get_all()
print(f"Found {len(feature_groups)} feature groups")

# Check if we have a feature group for our data
fg_name = "drift_detection_fg"
fg_version = 1

# Try to get or create the feature group
try:
    fg = fg_api.get(fg_name, version=fg_version)
    print(f"Found existing feature group: {fg.name} v{fg.version}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Feature group not found, will create: {e}")
    # Create feature group
    fg = fg_api.create(
        name=fg_name,
        version=fg_version,
        description="Feature group for drift detection",
        online_enabled=False
    )
    print(f"Created feature group: {fg.name} v{fg.version}")

# Upload the data
print("Uploading data...")
data_path = "data/features.csv"
fg_api.upload_feature_group(
    feature_group=fg,
    path=data_path,
    storage_connector=None,
    time_travel_format="HUDI"
)
print("Data uploaded successfully")

# Compute statistics
print("Computing statistics...")
statistics = stats_api.compute(
    feature_group=fg,
    start_date="2026-01-01",
    end_date="2026-03-31"
)
print(f"Statistics computed: {statistics}")

# Get statistics
stats_list = stats_api.get_all(feature_group=fg)
print(f"Found {len(stats_list)} statistics entries")

# Analyze for drift
# We need to look at the statistics and find which feature changed distribution
for stat in stats_list:
    print(f"Statistics: {stat.to_dict()}")

print("Done!")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hopsworks
import json
import os

# Login to Hopsworks
hopsworks.login()

# Get the feature store
proj = hopsworks.project.Project()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

print(f"Feature store: {fs.name}")

# Create or get feature group
fg_name = "drift_detection_fg"
fg_version = 1

try:
    fg = fs.get_feature_group(fg_name, version=fg_version)
    print(f"Found existing feature group: {fg.name} v{fg.version}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Creating feature group: {e}")
    fg = fs.create_feature_group(
        name=fg_name,
        version=fg_version,
        description="Feature group for drift detection",
        online_enabled=False
    )
    print(f"Created feature group: {fg.name} v{fg.version}")

# Upload the data
print("Uploading data...")
data_path = "data/features.csv"
try:
    fg.save(data_path)
    print("Data uploaded successfully")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error uploading data: {e}")
    # Try alternative method
    try:
        from hsfs.feature_group import FeatureGroup
        fg = FeatureGroup(name=fg_name, version=fg_version, featurestore_id=fs.id)
        fg.save(data_path)
        print("Data uploaded successfully (alternative method)")
    except Exception as e2:
        print(f"Error with alternative method: {e2}")

print("Done with upload!")

        name=fg_name,
        version=fg_version,
        description="Feature group for drift detection",
        online_enabled=False,
        path=upload_path,
        time_travel_format="HUDI",
        event_time="event_time"
    )
    print(f"Created feature group: {fg.name} v{fg.version}")

print("Done!")
